descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT Empty & Failure States 'Offline / no network'; UAT OAT-03 step 1 · “Clear "no network" message; dictation kept and retried when the connection returns”. Mixed: stated part — 20 s outage mid-dictation: no-network message, text kept and saved on reconnect; our part — 2 s blip, browser clock a day ahead while offline, reading the text from a second fresh browser context (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S12 Offline mid-dictation — a 2 s blip, a 20 s outage, a wrong device clock — then back online: no-network message, text stays, saved on reconnect under the server's today (both contexts; S14 merged here)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 Offline / no network: a clear 'no network' message; dictation kept and retried when the connection returns, so dropped hospital Wi-Fi does not lose a physician's dictation (UAT Empty & Failure States (Offline / no network); UAT OAT-03 Source; TFA-94745 state 9)
  • U3 The physician's already-entered dictation / encounter text is preserved whether or not the note succeeded; the original input is never lost in any failure state (UAT OAT-03 step 4; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94422 AC 5)
  • U13 All of the above in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android (UAT 3.3; UAT Empty & Failure States Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 6)
  • U15 Text kept during an outage and saved on reconnect lands on the server's 'today', whatever the device clock says (UAT 3.8)

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Fresh physician with one Hospital patient and one Nursing Home resident, chart open on the Encounter tab; a browser the harness launched and the agent drives over CDP, so the harness can switch the network and the clock

When Hospital: type line 1 during a 2 s blip, then line 2 during a 20 s outage, reconnect, reload. Nursing Home: type during a 20 s outage, reconnect, reload. Clock cell (Hospital, run last, fresh context): browser clock set one day ahead of the server, go offline, type line 3, reconnect

Then During each 20 s outage a clear no-network message shows and the typed text stays; after reconnect every line is on the server (read before the reload) and, after the reload, in the box and in a second fresh browser context; the clock-cell line lands in the encounter of the server's today, not the browser's (3.8)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Outage checkpoints mustContain 'no network' and the typed text; after-reload checkpoints mustContain every line and mustNotContain 'no network'. Backend, read once before the reload and once from a second fresh browser context, so a tail restored from IndexedDB 'roundcompanion-session-drafts' cannot stand in for the server: rounding:get encounterNotes = 'QA OAT-03 blip line. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)
